rows.grounds: optative injunction to eat or partake, object implied from prior context
locative adverb referring to the present ritual context
absence of uncertainty regarding the prescribed act

items.question: Is consumption of the ritual substances in this context subject to any doubt?
premises: The preceding context prescribes ritual substances for the left-hand path.
An optative injunction directs one to consume them.
Doubt concerning this prescribed act is explicitly negated.
items.inference: Therefore, one should consume the ritual substances in this context without doubt.
uncertainties: The specific objects of consumption are not named in this verse but are implied from the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: One should consume them in this case; there is no doubt.
